mention.lead_sentence: To facilitate understanding and further analysis, we give the schematic dia- gram of the network model , shown in Figure 1.

items.note: raster, one 514 by 404 px bitmap 141.7 by 111.4 pt: ten empty circles with green rings, the numerals 1 to 10 set black at their centres, joined by eleven plain thick black segments with no arrowheads, no edge labels, no weights, no legend, no frame and no axes. The layout is a three-tier ladder - 6 alone on top, the chain 1-2-3-4-5 across the middle, 7-8-9-10 hanging under 8 - so the graph is undirected and node 8 is its hub with four incident edges (4-8, 8-7, 8-9, 8-10). The caption is the left half of a two-column caption block printed under both panels and interleaved with Figure 2's left half in the text layer, so it is typed off the crop rather than cut from the layer. Cited twice by number, first on p5 one page before the art and again on p6 as 'In Figure 1, node 8 has the most node degree, or k8 = 4.'

items.note: raster, one 561 by 413 px bitmap 170.1 by 125.2 pt: a single dark-blue dash-dot-dot polyline with no markers, one panel, no legend, no gridlines and no title inside the plot. The frame is L-shaped on the bottom and RIGHT, an unusual corner: one baseline at the foot spanning 231 to 367 pt and one vertical at x 367 pt running up the right edge, with no left axis line and no top rule. The y ticks run 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3 and the x ticks 0.1 to 0.9 in steps of 0.1, with the leftmost label clipped and the 2.5 label smudged. Neither axis carries a printed title, so the prose has to name them E and u. The curve sits near 2.7 for u below 0.4, drops to 0.3 at 0.45 and 0.1 at 0.5, spikes back to 2.7 at 0.6 and is flat on the axis from 0.7 out. The prose reads stability off it: 'when u gets in the interval of [0.7,1] the variation of the results is relatively small', which the drawn range 0.1 to 0.9 does not contain.

note:
Eleven measured regions over nine of twenty-one pages, all accounted for: eleven rows - seven figures and four tables - no exclusions, no refusals, nothing unmeasured. The paper numbers seven figures and six tables, so three of the thirteen printed exhibits have no region and are declared gaps rather than invented boxes: Table 2 on p11, Table 4 on p15 and Table 6 on p19. All three are real booktabs grids - the drawing pass finds three ruled lines each, at 251.8, 272.5 and 423.1 pt over x 167.1 to 428.2 pt on p11, at 393.0, 411.1 and 477.0 pt over x 186.8 to 408.5 pt on p15 and at 142.9, 163.6 and 213.1 pt over x 164.4 to 430.9 pt on p19 - and they are lost because each set of rules spans only 261.1, 221.8 and 266.5 pt, between 37 and 45 per cent of the page width, while rule_table_regions collects a candidate rule only when it spans at least half the page. That is the same half-page threshold that made Table 6 of paper 9 a declared gap. Their contents are on the record here anyway: Table 2 lists ranks 1 to 10 of the influence ranking over Rank, Name and p; Table 4 lists the top five papers over rank, Paper's number, H, IF and r; Table 6 lists three researchers over Name, E and q.

One ruling register, seven times over, and one grid that breaks it. Every printed grid in the paper is booktabs - horizontal hairlines only, no vertical stroke anywhere in twenty-one pages - at 76.9, 82.2, 82.9 and 93.2 per cent of the 418.3 pt measure for the four counted grids. Table 3 is the exception in every other respect: its five rules bound three COLOUR ZONES of five, five and four rows rather than ruling rows, its header prints above the measured box, its shading fills only the Name cell of each row, and its four numeric columns are left-aligned so that 1 and 362 and -132 all start at the same ink edge. Table 1 is indented 14 pt from both margins, which is why its caption is indented with it, and Table 5 is centred column by column with its Name header 35 pt to the right of where its names start.

Defects recorded, not corrected: the prose beside Table 3 defines a red zone for the four researchers whose p-q goes negative, and the drawn third band is a pale teal with no red pixel anywhere in the table; Figure 7 is drawn over u from 0.1 to 0.9 while the paragraph beside it reads stability off 'the interval of [0.7,1]', which the plot does not cover; Figure 4's caption ends with the stray word 'network'; Figure 6's lower arrow is labelled 1 followed by a glyph that prints as a question mark where the prose requires u; Figure 4 leaves the graph in two components and an isolated node 5 while Figure 3 leaves it in one, although the prose pairs the two as equal; Table 5's fifth column is headed 'box-office' with no unit and its caption calls the ranks 'the movie starts'; Table 1's rank 2 carries an asterisk no footnote explains; and Figures 2 and 4 use red rings to mark the isolated nodes with no legend anywhere in the paper. The prose typos stand as printed: 'The researcher is importance degree in the net-work', 'It is unquestionable that the feedback of citing is subsistent', 'Similarity, we define E as the index', 'we find some interesting phenomenon,we show it in Table 3' with no space after the comma, and the paragraph on p16 that repeats 'we decide to replace the Erdos in the previous network model with him' twice.
rules: rows counts every printed row including the header band, and never the number of bands between rules: Table 3's five rules bound three colour zones of five, five and four rows, so its four body bands and its fifteen printed rows are different numbers [table.rows]

a header that prints outside the measured box is still the grid's header: Table 3's two-line header sits between the 142.9 pt toprule and the 192.4 pt midrule, above the region the geometry pass returns, and is counted as one header row all the same [table.header_rows]
a two-line header band is one header row, not two: 'q' over 'rank' and 'p' over 'rank' are five columns' worth of labels set on two lines [table.header_rows]

every printed grid in this paper is booktabs: seven grids, three horizontal hairlines each, no vertical rule anywhere in twenty-one pages, so rule_style is booktabs and zebra is false throughout [table.rule_style]
a fill behind one cell is not zebra striping: Table 3 shades only the Name cell of each row, in three colour zones that mark the prose's stable, positive and negative bands [table.zebra]
a grid over 75 per cent of the local measure is full: the four counted grids run 76.9, 82.2, 82.9 and 93.2 per cent of the 418.3 pt measure and each percentage is named in its note [table.width]

a column of equal-width values is not decimal alignment: Table 1's q column is 0.xxxx eleven times and Table 5's two score columns are 0.xxxx ten times each, so nothing is aligned on a point and decimal_aligned is false in all four grids [table.decimal_aligned]

a note_sentence must be a printed sentence on the grid's own page or the next one; Table 3's only naming sentence, 'we show it in Table 3', prints on p11 and so the field is empty and the pointer goes into the item note [table.note_sentence]
an uncaptioned table records numbering none and an empty verbatim: p5's symbol list prints a header band and no caption line at all, its title being the section heading above it [caption.numbering]

a two-column caption block interleaved in the text layer is typed off the crop: the four captions on pp. 6 and 7 print in two halves side by side and the layer reads them alternately, so caption_source is typed-from-crop and the caption quote is skipped [caption.verbatim]

printed_numbers records numerals the art carries of its own - node ids on the six network panels and tick labels on the case-extension chart - and data_labels records names set inside the art, which only Figure 6's A and B do [geometry.printed_numbers]
an exhibit the prose never numbers by name keeps count 0 with first_page null: Figure 6 and the p5 symbol list print a caption or a title and are pointed at nowhere [mention.count]

a citation that lands a page BEFORE the exhibit keeps its first page and records lead_pages 1, and one that lands after it records a negative lead: Figure 1 is first named on p5, Table 5 only on p17 [mention.lead_pages]

a bitmap that prints labelled discs joined by arrows is node-link-network and not flowchart-or-schematic, whether the edges carry arrowheads or not, so all six graphs here share one family [geometry.family]

tables.note: Booktabs, three rules at 184.8, 205.6 and 327.5 pt spanning 321.5 pt, no vertical rule anywhere, and the only counted grid in the paper with no caption: the band between the top rule and the header text is blank, so the table's only title is the section heading directly above it, '3 Symbol Description'. Six printed rows over two columns, Symbol and Description, and the five symbols are p, q, H, IF and E with the node index as a subscript. Three of the five descriptions wrap to two lines, which is why the body band runs 122 pt for five rows. 321.5 pt against the 418.3 pt measure (76.9 per cent), inset from both margins. Description is the only text column and the symbol column is centred display maths, so no column is decimal-aligned. The prose that introduces it is one sentence and never names a number, and the paper never changes that: the list is referred to nowhere after it prints.
